what: Plan routes generic outer-loop exhaustion to ci-fix-exhausted even when no fix ran
scenario_or_breakage: If gh-run-logs/read_failed_jobs stay in progress, callers skip vendor dispatch and then hit the shared max-retries terminal; proposed exit-3/NEEDS_USER_INPUT would launch main-agent CI fix without ready logs or failed jobs
suggested_fix: Gate ci-fix-exhausted on a ready-log fix attempt actually exhausting; keep in-progress/no-dispatch exhaustion on the existing stalled/waterfall-failed path and retain or update the in-progress regression
